primary_contrast: official Windows to optimized Windows: practical adoption
secondary_contrast: pgo-control to optimized: added ThinLTO with byte-identical frontend and LLVM profiles
secondary_endpoints: CPU time, each native command, original common-package and WASM controls
profile: Original Cargo profiles and per-package test overrides; debug=0, incremental=0, jobs=4; no opt-level or codegen-unit overrides
cold_artifacts: Fresh native/common/WASM targets per compiler/round; five native commands share one initially empty native target
order: Counterbalanced rotation by VM and round, reversing alternate rounds
correctness: All four original native cargo test commands per compiler/VM after round zero, outside timing; no extra filters or ignores
cpu_accounting: Windows private shared Job Object deltas include all descendant CPU inside each timed window, including exact native vswhere-discovered vctip helpers; Linux wait4
native_process_isolation: MSBUILDDISABLENODEREUSE=1 for every variant; only exact native vctip helpers may persist; no helper CPU subtraction
aggregation: Sum five native command times per block; average measured rounds within VM; equal-weight VM means
uncertainty: 10000 seeded paired Windows / independently resampled Linux whole-VM bootstrap draws; 95% percentile intervals
exclusions: Exclude pilot and fixed warmup; reject incomplete/failed matrices and mixed workflow attempts; no slow-sample trimming
scope: Offline cold compilation only; not whole CI elapsed time, production compiler construction, or proof that official x64 LLVM PGO is ineffective
